verdict.rationale: Reclaim.ai runs continuous background automations—auto-scheduling/rescheduling Tasks, Habits, Focus Time, buffers, and travel time without manual reshuffling—which is a real form of autonomous, persistent automation, and community testimonials corroborate this behavior (e.g., proactive scheduling, hands-off operation). However, this is calendar-domain automation rather than general-purpose 'agentic' automation across arbitrary tasks/tools, and at least one user reported a sync automation not working as expected. missing for 10: evidence of broader/cross-domain autonomous automations beyond calendar scheduling, a clear framework for user-defined custom automations/triggers, and stronger independent verification of reliability at scale.
